about.label: About the Band
about.heading: A Miami band built to fill the dance floor
about.body: ZikoFranco is a power trio — Ziko on vocals, JCConcepcion on lead guitar and a live drummer — backed by professional tracks for a full-band sound. Modern rock power meets funk-forward groove and a Santana-inspired Latin edge, arranged into seamless medleys that keep every crowd moving, in English and Spanish.

items.q: How much does it cost to book ZikoFranco?
items.a: Pricing depends on the date, how much live music you want and the location. Send a quick request with your event details and we'll reply within 24–48 hours with availability and a clear quote.
We offer a 50-minute Party Set, a Two-Set Celebration (about 2 hours with a break) and our signature Full Miami Live Show: three 50-minute sets over 3 hours.
ZikoFranco is a power trio — Ziko on lead vocals, JCConcepcion on lead guitar and a live drummer — backed by professional tracks, so you get a full-band sound with a compact setup.
Yes. We're fully bilingual and mix English and Spanish hits, from Bruno Mars and Bon Jovi to Santana and Celia Cruz, so every guest feels included.
Absolutely. Send us your must-play and do-not-play lists. With enough notice we can prepare a special song for a first dance, an entrance or another big moment.

items.q: What do you need from the venue?
items.a: A performance area and access to power. Tell us whether the venue has a sound system (PA) when you request a quote and we'll plan the setup together.
We're based in Miami and play across South Florida — Miami-Dade, Broward and Palm Beach. Travel beyond that is available on request.

items.q: How do we reserve our date?
items.a: Once you approve your quote, a deposit secures the date. We confirm everything in writing so you know exactly what to expect.
